Hi Elena / Tim —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our discovery call, I drafted a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) to capture milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can align on a realistic path to pilot and procurement. This is intentionally lightweight — please review and tell us what to change.

Quick summary / ask:
- Attachment: Draft_MAP_v1.xlsx — initial milestones and two timeline options (Standard / Accelerated).
- Please confirm: who on your side will own technical validation, security/compliance sign-off, and procurement (name + email).
- Pick the timeframe you prefer (Option A: 8-week pilot -> production pilot; Option B: 5-week accelerated).
- Any blocking dependencies (contract legal review, SOC-2 evidence, firewall/opening ports) we should add to the plan?

Draft milestones (high level):
1) Kickoff & MAP alignment — agree stakeholders and target close date (this week) — owner: Elena
2) Technical POC setup — infra & test data — owner: Jordan (Redwood) + your infra lead
3) Eval & quality review — run sample workload, QoQ checks — owner: Tim (NovaMed)
4) Procurement & contract execution — legal/pricing — owner: Elena + procurement
5) Pilot to production rollout — ops handoff — owner: Lauren (Redwood)

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm stakeholder names by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-11)?
- If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute MAP kickoff on Thursday (Nov 12) to finalize owners and the target close date.

Attachments referenced: Draft_MAP_v1.xlsx, Discovery_Notes_Novamed.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
